title: BAH Casa | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: BAH Casa is a 6.00 bedroom, 7.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: BAH Casa is ideally situated beside Rosemary Beach, offering a rare combination of luxury living and coastal convenience. This thoughtfully designed home features five bedrooms with private bathrooms in the main residence along with a one-bedroom carriage home complete with a full kitchen, living area, private balcony, and ensuite above the two-car garage. In total, the property offers six bedrooms, 6 full bathrooms and 2 half bathrooms, and an outdoor shower, making it the perfect retreat for families and groups seeking both comfort and privacy. Multiple balconies throughout the home provide relaxing spots to enjoy coastal breezes and views, adding to its inviting charm. A six-seater golf cart is included with your stay, giving guests an easy and enjoyable way to explore nearby beaches, cafés, and local shops. Located just steps from sugar-white sand and the lively restaurants and boutiques of both Rosemary Beach and Inlet Beach, this home offers a lifestyle where every day feels like a vacation.The first floor welcomes you with a grand foyer, where both a curved staircase and elevator connect all levels of the home. The open living and dining area includes a fireplace and custom built-ins, while the chef’s kitchen is outfitted with premium appliances, a butler’s pantry, and a wet bar with wine fridge and icemaker. A junior master suite with king bed and private bathroom is located on this level, along with a powder bath, mudroom, and the first of two laundry rooms.From the living space, French doors open to a sunroom-style covered porch with a fireplace, outdoor dining, and comfortable seating. The courtyard is designed for relaxation and entertainment, featuring a heated saltwater pool with sun shelf, full summer kitchen with grill, sink, refrigerator, and icemaker, landscaped turf yard, firepit deck with Adirondack chairs, and both an outdoor shower and powder bath. These inviting spaces create an effortless flow between indoor and outdoor living.On the second floor, the primary suite serves as a private retreat with a king bed, sitting area with morning bar, and a balcony overlooking the pool courtyard. The ensuite bathroom includes a soaking tub, walk-in shower, double vanity, private toilet, and spacious walk-in closet. Two additional king bedrooms with private bathrooms are also located on this level, along with a built-in window bench and second laundry room.The third floor offers a secondary living space and a custom bunk room with two built-in bunks, including a twin-over-full and twin-over-twin, paired with a full bathroom. A bar area with refrigerator, sink, and icemaker makes this the ideal gathering spot for kids and teens after a day on the beach.At the top, the fourth-floor tower delivers panoramic Gulf views with a covered lounge space, ceiling sound system, and TV hook-up. This elevated perch provides the perfect setting for sunset gatherings or simply enjoying the coastal breezes while overlooking Rosemary Beach and Inlet Beach.Beach Access & Lifestyle:This property is just a block from the beach access at Winston and a block from downtown Rosemary Beach, making it easy to enjoy sugar-white sand, local cafés, restaurants, and boutiques. Whether it’s mornings by the pool, walking to nearby cafés, or ending evenings in the tower with stunning Gulf views, this home provides the perfect balance of luxury and authentic coastal living.Nearby Attractions:You can easily explore a variety of nearby dining, shopping, and entertainment destinations, including:* Shades, George's Alys Beach, Peddlers Pavilion* Rosemary Downtown: The Pearl, Sugar Shack* 30Avenue: Amigos, Amicis, Idyll Proper, Attycat's Arcade* Watersound Towncenter: Publix, Ambrosia, Village Market, Nigels, Sweet HenriettasYour stay at BAH Casa comes with Xplorie’s best activities! Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!Additional Information:* Sorry, no pets allowed.* Parking for 4 cars only. (2 of the spots will be in the garage)* Complimentary 6-seater golf cart.A starter set of amenities is provided: The kitchen includes paper towels, a sponge, dish soap, dishwasher pods, kitchen wipes, trash liners, and laundry pods. Each bathroom has toilet paper, facial and bath soaps, body wash, shampoo, and conditioner. Towels include one body towel and washcloth per guest, plus two hand towels per bathroom.
